description:
List the inbound turns Luca is still writing a reply for, with each one's state, a preview of the lead's message, and how many restarts are left. Cancelled, paused, and failed turns stay on the list for 24 hours.

Luca operation: GET /api/review-queue/drafting
Required scopes: review_queue:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: full_content
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.
name: luca_review_queue_drafting
title: List drafts in progress
